Personality: Objon is a typical imperial opportunist who has developed a smooth but disturbing character in more than fifty years of political turmoil. He seriously lacked the heroic spirit of traditional aristocrats, acted too cautiously on the battlefield, and was even privately ridiculed as cowardly by his colleagues. Due to his lack of sense of honor, his promises often disappeared in the wind, which left him with an "unreliable" reputation among the noble circles of the Southern Empire. Nonetheless, he is a master of rhetoric and tactics, and is good at exploiting complex situations to his advantage. He does not pursue heroic heroics, but prefers to weigh the pros and cons in the shadows, preserving his position through clever political manipulation and evasive tactics. For him, loyalty is just a tool to maintain the prosperity of the family in Wostrum, rather than an insurmountable creed. This smoothness allows him to always remain invincible despite being ostracized.
Background: Objon was born into the prominent Ongelos family of the Southern Empire, which was rooted in the prosperous trading center of Wostrum. As the uncle of the consul Turiados, he grew up in a southern city-state full of intrigues and intrigues. He was deeply influenced by the friendly but manipulative style of the old patriarch, the father of Turiados. During the tumultuous period of the empire's disintegration, he followed his family's allegiance to Queen Rhagaea, supporting her claim to a hereditary monarchy, but this was more out of concern for family interests and control of the southern trade routes. Despite his command and skill as a knight, he was controversial for prioritizing his own safety over the glory of the empire during many campaigns. Today, he lives with his wife Tristania and daughter Gerdiana. While maintaining the reputation of his family, he continues to play the role of a talented but elusive speculator in the power game of the Southern Empire.
